verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents Capacity Finder in the Cloud Console. It lets users compare placement availability across Zones for one or more GPU and CPU instance types and a Node count before creating a Spot Node Pool, which directly addresses checking availability before provisioning. Evidence is limited to the Spot Node Pool docs and is console-only. missing for 10: explicit real-time/freshness guarantees, documentation that Capacity Finder covers on-demand/reserved capacity beyond Spot, programmatic (API/Terraform) access to availability data, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can see real-time GPU availability by type and region before I try to provision, instead of discovering stockouts by failure

citations.quote: Before you create a Spot Node Pool, use Capacity Finder in the Cloud Console to compare placement availability across Zones for your requested instance type and Node count.
use Capacity Finder in the Cloud Console to compare placement availability across Zones for one or more GPU and CPU instance types
